name: Workboard Controller
description: Automatically dispatches Workboard ready cards after terminal events and wakes owners on problem events.

enabled.description: Start the controller service on Gateway startup. Default true.

boardId.description: Workboard board id to watch. Default default.

subscriptionId.description: Existing Workboard notification subscription id to reuse.

target.description: Notification subscription target marker. Default workboard-controller.

pollIntervalMs.description: Notification poll interval in milliseconds. Default 15000.

batchLimit.description: Maximum Workboard notifications to process per tick. Default 50.

dispatchCooldownMs.description: Minimum delay between dispatch calls. Default 2000.

dispatchTimeoutMs.description: Gateway dispatch timeout in milliseconds. Default 60000.

wakeEnabled.description: Wake owner sessions on failed/stale/blocked events. Default true.

wakeFallbackSessionKey.description: Fallback session key when an event/card has no linked session.

wakeFallbackAgentId.description: Fallback agent id when an event/card has no agent. Default main.

wakeTimeoutMs.description: Problem wake embedded-agent timeout in milliseconds. Default 120000.

wakeToolsAllow.description: Optional tool allowlist for problem wake runs.

compatibleOpenClawVersions.description: Exact OpenClaw versions accepted by this compatibility seam.

allowUntestedOpenClawVersion.description: Disable exact OpenClaw version fail-fast. Default false.
